links.outcome: Diagnostic sensitivity of ChatGPT-4o for OSCC, oral leukoplakia and oral lichen planus from clinical photographs
links.effect: Sensitivity was 65% for OSCC, 60% for OL and 25% for OLP; specificity 96.1-100%; a significant proportion of true cases were missed, so it cannot serve as a standalone diagnostic tool.
links.quote: Nevertheless, its sensitivity remains insufficient, as a significant proportion of true cases were missed, underscoring that the model cannot be relied upon as a standalone diagnostic tool.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and sensitivity/specificity of ChatGPT-4o on oral pathology clinical images against expert ground truth without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
